title: StandardAero’s Augusta, GA Facility Joins Rolls-Royce Authorized Service Center Network for Tay and BR710 Line Maintenance for CorporateCare® Customers
summary: SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. – October 19, 2026 – StandardAero (NYSE: SARO), a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services, including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), and engine component repair today announced that its Augusta, GA facility has joined the Rolls-Royce Authorized Service Center (ASC) network, adding line maintenance engine support for the Tay […]
body_markdown:
**SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. – October 19** **, 2026 –** ****[StandardAero](https://standardaero.com/) (NYSE: SARO), a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services, including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), and engine component repair today announced that its Augusta, GA facility has joined the Rolls-Royce Authorized Service Center (ASC) network, adding line maintenance engine support for the Tay 611-8/8C and BR710 A1 /C4 engine series.


With this addition, operators of Tay or BR710-powered Gulfstream G300, G400, IV, IV SP, G350, G450, GV, G500 and G550 aircraft on a Rolls-Royce CorporateCare® contract can now access on-site engine line maintenance at StandardAero Augusta, including line maintenance inspections, troubleshooting, and engine removal and replacement, independent of or alongside their airframe maintenance events.


“Adding Augusta to the powerful network of Rolls-Royce Authorized Service Centers is a natural extension of the investment we’ve made in that facility over the past year,” said Giovanni Spitale, President of StandardAero Business Aviation. “CorporateCare customers will receive the same high quality support in Augusta, just as they’ve relied on from our airframe service centers in Springfield and Van Nuys, backed by the full strength of our Rolls-Royce relationship.”


Across three airframe service centers, StandardAero’s coverage for Rolls-Royce CorporateCare customers now includes: Augusta, GA – Tay 611-8/8C and BR710 A1 /C4, Springfield, IL – Tay 611-8/8C, and Van Nuys, CA – Tay 611-8/8C, BR710 A1/A2/C4 and BR725 A1-12.


“CorporateCare is about giving our customers confidence that expert support is available when and where they need it. By adding StandardAero Augusta as an experienced and reliable partner to our powerful network of over 85 Authorized Service Centers worldwide, we are further strengthening support for our growing CorporateCare customer base in the region, helping them minimise potential disruptions and keep their aircraft flying,” said Andy Robinson, SVP Services – Business Aviation, Rolls-Royce. StandardAero Augusta began performing Gulfstream aircraft inspections, repairs and connectivity installations earlier this year after opening a new hangar in August 2025 built specifically to support Gulfstream aircraft.


“The new Tay and BR710 CorporateCare authorization builds on our investment into Gulfstream operators in the region, reinforcing our commitment to coast-to-coast support across the United States,” said Chris Bodine, Vice President & General Manager, StandardAero Augusta. “Our team is ready to support these operators, providing reduced engine services turn time with our authorization to supply OEM-approved support on-site for CorporateCare customers.”


The Augusta authorization adds to StandardAero’s broader business aviation-focused Rolls-Royce relationship. StandardAero is a Rolls-Royce Authorized Maintenance Center (AMC) for Spey and Tay engine MRO in Dallas, TX, and for the AE3007 engine in Maryville, TN, and is OEM-authorized to provide line maintenance and AOG mobile service support for the Spey, Tay, BR710 and AE3007 engine lines.


StandardAero Augusta supports airframe services for select Bombardier Challenger, Dassault Falcon, Embraer Legacy, Hawker and Gulfstream aircraft, as well as comprehensive heavy MRO for Honeywell HTF7000, TFE731 and 36 series APU. Augusta also provides line maintenance for select AE3007, CF34, CFE738, and PW300 engine models, plus the added Rolls-Royce CorporateCare Tay and BR710 line support. The facility is certified by the FAA, EASA, ANAC, AFAC and civil aviation authorities in Aruba, Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, Chile, Colombia, South Africa and Uruguay. For more information on[StandardAero Augusta](https://standardaero.com/aboutus/locations/augusta-ga/) , visit www.standardaero.com.


###


**StandardAero** is a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services for fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft, serving the commercial, military and business aviation end markets. StandardAero provides a comprehensive suite of critical, value-added aftermarket solutions, including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul, engine component repair, on-wing and field service support, asset management and engineering solutions. StandardAero is an NYSE-listed company under the ticker symbol SARO.
